glosses: trophy (set of the enemy's spoils that remain in the hands of the victor)

examples.text: Tom ganhou o troféu três vezes.
examples.en: Tom has won the trophy three times.

examples.text: Ela o presenteou com o troféu.
examples.en: She presented him with the trophy.

examples.text: Tom estava parado perto da estante de troféus.
examples.en: Tom was standing near the trophy case.

examples.text: O Tom estava parado perto da estante de troféus.
examples.en: Tom was standing near the trophy case.
